"Some of the world's most fascinating wildlife stories unfold beneath the water, far from sight. Jeremy Wade investigates reports of unusual fish, mysterious aquatic creatures and unexpected encounters, travelling from Alaska to Australia's Fitzroy River and beyond. Each discovery raises another question about what could be hiding in the depths.
Watch Jeremy Wade's Dark Waters, Season 1, Episodes 1, 4, 7, 2, 3, 8 and 5 on Discovery Channel India"
